name: geometer
description: Set up, check and run shop agents from Claude Code: pick an agent template, tighten its limits, crash test it, go live and make the monthly client report. A person confirms limits and go-live in the panel, outside the chat.

agents_dir.title: Agents checkout
agents_dir.description: Your clone of GeometerLabs/agents (the folder with bundle/geometer.ts in it). The plugin runs its code; it does not carry a copy.

server_dir.title: Server folder
server_dir.description: The folder `geometer init` made on your server (the one with geometer.json). Keys never go in here from the chat.
